ns2:section.sectionText: Online and Continuing Education (OCE) restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.oce.illinois.edu. This section is reserved for non-degree seeking students. To assure a seat in this course, please register by August 13, 2012 as we cannot guarantee registration after this date. This is an accelerated 8 week course and may require more time commitment per week than a traditional 16 week course. Go to the following URL: https://courses.las.illinois.edu to access the Moodle course management system login page. Undergraduate students should take course for 3 credit hours and Graduate students should take course for 4 credit hours. On-campus degree-seeking students must enroll in the on-campus course instead of this online course section.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to NDEG:Grad Nondegree-CE-UIUC or NDEG:Undergrad Nondeg-CE-UIUC.
ns2:section.sectionFeeAmount: Graduate - Urbana-Champaign OCE Tuition $380.00 per Bill Hour, Undergrad - Urbana-Champaign OCE Tuition $347.00 per Bill Hour, and OCE Fees $50.00 per Bill Hour.
